# Test fixtures

Every value in these fixtures is invented for testing. In particular, `grid.csv` and the files in
`electricitymaps/` imitate the *format* of an Electricity Maps yearly export, but their numbers are
made up and are not Electricity Maps data. `gsf/` is a hand-made slice in the format of the Green
Software Foundation's cloud-region file, and `corpus/` describes fictional organizations.
